Money Market Fund Assets

November 6, 2026

Washington, DC; November 6, 2026—Total money market fund assets increased by $33.62 billion to $7.42 trillion for the week ended Wednesday, November 5, the Investment Company Institute reported today.

Among taxable money market funds, government funds increased by $30.12 billion and prime funds increased by $4.10 billion. Tax-exempt money market funds decreased by $0.60 billion.
